name: Sikalastic®-888
tagline: Two component solvent free 100% solids pure Polyurea
summary: Sikalastic®-888 is a two component, solvent free, flexible polyurea membrane system with good chemical resistance properties. Sikalastic®-888 is 100% solids and has been formulated to be spray applied using plural component spray equipment.
metaDescription: Sikalastic®-888 is a two component, solvent free, flexible polyurea membrane system with good chemical resistance properties. Sikalastic®-888 is 100% solids and has been formulated to be spray applied using plural component spray equipment.
attributes: Very fast reactivity and curing time
Performs in constant dry temperatures from -30°C to +100°C
Can be applied on polystyrene/ polyurethane foams
Not resistant to biogenic sulphuric acid
usage: Sikalastic®-888 is ideal for the following applications:
Abrasion resistant protective coating in industrial and manufacturing facilities
Waterproofing for cut and cover structures
Waterproofing on floors and car park decks
Water retaining structures in power plants
Secondary containment structures Tank, bund and pit lining in sewage and waste water treatment plants

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry and cool conditions protected from direct sunlight.

items.label: System structure
items.text:
CONCRETE SUBSTRATE APPLICATIONS:
Coating System | Product | Consumption
Primer Coat | Sikalastic 100 EP Primer/Sikafloor 160 (epoxy primer) | 0.2 - 0.4kg/m² (depending on substrate porosity)
Primer Broadcast | 0.3-0.8mm kiln dried quartz sand | 1.0-1.5kg/m²
Membrane Coat | Sikalastic 888 | approx. 1.033kg/m²/mm
Sikalastic 100 EP Primer must be used as the primer for potable water applications.
If Sikalastic 100 EP Primer/Sikafloor 160 is being overcoated with Sikalastic®-888 within 24 hours of application, sand broadcasting is not required.
Please note for substrates containing moisture (up to 6%) we suggest substituting primer for Sikalastic Moisture Seal.
For adhesion to other substrates than concrete please contact Sika Technical for advice.

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text:
+1°C ~ +50°C
≥ 3°C above dew point, beware of condensation

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Dose and mix with a suitable air driven or electrical plural component heated spray equipment. Both components must be heated up to +60 °C. The accuracy of mixing and dosage must be controlled regularly with the equipment. Thoroughly stir part B (Amine) using a drum stirrer until a homogenous colour is obtained.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools with Thinner C immediately after use. The application equipment has to cleaned and filled with Mesamoll. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.

rel.s: Sikalastic® Moisture Seal is a two part, water-based, epoxy which chemically cures to form a waterproof vapour barrier that is hydrostatic pressure resistant and can prevent rising
